title: SSB Pub
description: Run an invite-only Scuttlebutt Pub. It stores and replicates feeds and blobs using ssb-db2 and EBT.

SSB_PORT.title: Direct SSB TCP (optional)
SSB_PORT.description: Use direct TCP when your Pub DNS name resolves directly to Cloudron. With this port disabled, invites use secure WebSockets on HTTPS.

changelog: Security update for Manyverse admin sign-in, WebSocket and replication traffic, and invitation claims.
postInstallMessage: Open the app’s **Web Terminal** and run `/app/code/pubctl admin`. Paste your public Manyverse SSB ID. Open the app, choose **Admin sign-in**, and approve with Manyverse. The **Pub settings** page lets you edit the profile and create invitations. For a password fallback, run `/app/code/pubctl password` in the Web Terminal.
